full_name: Santiago Mostyn | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2024–2025 Arts David and Roberta Logie Fellow Independent Artist (Sweden)
bio: Santiago Mostyn is an artist whose practice foregrounds narrative entanglements in pursuit of new understandings of place, both in a cultural and psychic sense.
